name: Sparse Voxel DAG Ray Traversal
aliases: Ray tracing a sparse voxel DAG
definition: A GPU-based ray tracing method using CUDA to traverse a Sparse Voxel DAG for visibility queries (shadows, AO) and primary ray intersection.
summary: Sparse Voxel DAG Ray Traversal is a GPU method that efficiently traverses compressed sparse voxel graphs for visibility queries, distinguishing itself by exploiting node sharing to reduce memory while handling graph cycles.
